annotations.title: List the parent's children on SATCoach

description: Lists the parent's children that SATCoach shares with this connection: the children whose student account is linked to this parent account, as on the parent dashboard. For each child: child (the reference the other tools take), label (the child's first name, unless the parent renamed it in SATCoach), test, test date, target score, daily goal (questions a day), and whether the child has a tutor. Also returns contextWeNeed: up to 3 short questions about missing context. For when the parent asks which of their children are on SATCoach, or has more than one child and a child reference is needed. With one child, the other tools work without child. Not for finding a child who isn't listed: SATCoach doesn't share that child here, and asking for one returns not_found. Requires a connected SATCoach parent account.
name: list_children
